note: Tool->camera mount (PLACEHOLDER — calibrate in P4). The camera is mounted on the toolhead (the two lenses in assets/tool.glb). Camera frame: x->right, y->down, z->forward (optical axis). tool_cam is the fixed transform from the KUKA $FLANGE (tool) frame to the camera frame. z_cam_default is the focal length in pixels (the optical-axis term for offset_to_base_direction).
